cards: Drink water. Text your mom. Ship the thing.
Your first attempt is supposed to be rough. That's how you can tell it's a first attempt and not a final answer.
Nobody at the gym is watching you. They're too busy worrying that you're watching them.
"Someday" is not a day of the week. Tuesday works. Today is fine too.
You're not behind. There's no schedule. There's just your life and everybody else's highlight reel.
Fix it, learn from it, or laugh about it later. Those are the options. Sometimes all three, in that order.
Rest is not a reward for finishing. Rest is part of how finishing happens.
The group chat believes in you. Loudly. With memes. That's still believing.
